data: {{Top}} {{Character |type=Galactic Republic |image=[[File:SahenIdane.jpg]] |name=Sahen Idane |homeworld= |birth= |death= |species=[[Human]]''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'' |gender= |pronouns= |height= |mass= |hair=[[Color|Brown]] {{C|graying}} |feathers= |eyes=Brown |skin=Light |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*[[Galactic Republic]] **[[Galactic Senate]] |masters= |apprentices= }} '''Sahen Idane''' was a [[human]] who served as a [[senator]] in the [[Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic]] during the [[High Republic Era]], representing the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]]''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' [[Chommell sector]]. As spokesperson for this [[Sector|area]] of [[Realspace|space]], Sahen Idane was a close associate of the [[Monarch of Naboo|elected monarchs]] that ruled the [[planet]] [[Naboo]] — which fell within Chommell sector — and the senator wore fineries from the [[capital]] city of [[Theed]] and a [[belt]] [[sash]] that had been given to them as a gift from [[Queen]] [[Yovité]]. In [[132 BBY]],{{TheAcolyteDate}} Idane was also considered a long-time affiliate of the [[Jedi]], a nontheistic order that worked alongside the Republic to defend [[the galaxy]]. {{Char-stub}} ==Appearances== *{{Acolyte|The Acolyte (episode)}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SWYouTube|9ajCIM6U5UA|The Acolyte | The Costumes of The Acolyte | Disney+}} {{Video}} *{{SW|url=news/ilm-the-acolyte-vfx-interview|text=Lightsabers & Magic: Visual Effects Supervisor Julian Foddy on The Acolyte's Creatures and Weapons of the Jedi}} {{Po}} *''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'' {{1stID|Sahen Idane}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=საჰენ იდეინი |nl=Sahen Idane }} [[Category:Galactic Republic senators during the High Republic Era]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]]
